model.fernwood.stg_storefront__customers.name: stg_storefront__customers
model.fernwood.stg_storefront__customers.description: Staging model over source storefront.customers: renames and light cleaning, one row per source row.

substr(email, instr(email, '@') + 1) as email_domain,
first_name, last_name, phone,
marketing_opt_in as is_marketing_opted_in, created_at

model.fernwood.int_customer_identity.name: int_customer_identity
model.fernwood.int_customer_identity.description: Unifies storefront customers with CRM contacts.
model.fernwood.int_customer_identity.raw_code:
select c.customer_id, c.email, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as full_name, c.phone,
k.date_of_birth, k.loyalty_tier, c.created_at as first_seen_at
from {{ ref('stg_storefront__customers') }} c
left join {{ ref('stg_crm__contacts') }} k on k.customer_id = c.customer_id

model.fernwood.int_orders_enriched.name: int_orders_enriched
model.fernwood.int_orders_enriched.description: Orders with item counts, net amounts and payment status.
model.fernwood.int_orders_enriched.raw_code:
select o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.ordered_at, o.order_status,
o.subtotal_usd as gross_amount_usd, o.discount_usd,
round(o.subtotal_usd - o.discount_usd, 2) as net_amount_usd,
coalesce(i.item_count, 0) as item_count, p.payment_status
from {{ ref('stg_storefront__orders') }} o
left join (select order_id, sum(quantity) as item_count
from {{ ref('stg_storefront__order_items') }} group by order_id) i
on i.order_id = o.order_id
left join (select order_id, payment_status, max(processed_at)
from {{ ref('stg_payments__transactions') }} group by order_id) p
on p.order_id = o.order_id

model.fernwood.int_customer_order_stats.name: int_customer_order_stats
model.fernwood.int_customer_order_stats.description: Per-customer order counts, first/last order and net revenue.
model.fernwood.int_customer_order_stats.raw_code:
select customer_id, min(ordered_at) as first_order_at, max(ordered_at) as last_order_at,
count(*) as order_count, round(sum(net_amount_usd), 2) as net_revenue_usd
from {{ ref('int_orders_enriched') }}
where order_status != 'cancelled'
group by customer_id

model.fernwood.int_campaign_touches.name: int_campaign_touches
model.fernwood.int_campaign_touches.description: One row per hashed recipient and campaign with open/click flags.
model.fernwood.int_campaign_touches.raw_code:
select e.recipient_email_sha256, e.campaign_id, c.channel,
max(e.event_type = 'opened') as opened, max(e.event_type = 'clicked') as clicked,
min(e.event_at) as touched_at
from {{ ref('stg_marketing__email_events') }} e
join {{ ref('stg_marketing__campaigns') }} c on c.campaign_id = e.campaign_id
group by e.recipient_email_sha256, e.campaign_id

model.fernwood.int_web_sessions.name: int_web_sessions
model.fernwood.int_web_sessions.description: Page views rolled up to sessions.
model.fernwood.int_web_sessions.raw_code:
select session_id, max(customer_id) as customer_id, ip_address,
min(viewed_at) as session_start, count(*) as page_count,
page_path as landing_page
from {{ ref('stg_web__page_views') }}
group by session_id

model.fernwood.dim_customers.name: dim_customers
model.fernwood.dim_customers.description: One row per customer: contact details, loyalty tier and order history. Customer 360 core table.

is_active.name: is_active
is_active.description: Ordered in last 365 days (see Active Customer)

model.fernwood.dim_customers.raw_code:
select i.customer_id, i.email, i.full_name, i.phone, i.loyalty_tier,
s.first_order_at, s.last_order_at,
coalesce(s.order_count, 0) as lifetime_order_count,
coalesce(s.last_order_at >= datetime('2026-10-01 00:00:00', '-365 days'), 0) as is_active
from {{ ref('int_customer_identity') }} i
left join {{ ref('int_customer_order_stats') }} s on s.customer_id = i.customer_id

model.fernwood.dim_products.name: dim_products
model.fernwood.dim_products.description: One row per product with catalog attributes.

model.fernwood.fct_orders.name: fct_orders
model.fernwood.fct_orders.description: One row per order with gross and net amounts.

model.fernwood.fct_order_items.name: fct_order_items
model.fernwood.fct_order_items.description: One row per order line with product category and line amount.
model.fernwood.fct_order_items.raw_code:
select i.order_item_id, i.order_id, i.product_id, p.category, i.quantity,
i.unit_price_usd, round(i.quantity * i.unit_price_usd, 2) as line_amount_usd
from {{ ref('stg_storefront__order_items') }} i
join {{ ref('dim_products') }} p on p.product_id = i.product_id

model.fernwood.fct_payments.name: fct_payments
model.fernwood.fct_payments.description: One row per payment transaction, including partial card details.

model.fernwood.customer_lifetime_value.name: customer_lifetime_value
model.fernwood.customer_lifetime_value.description: Customer lifetime value to date, 12-month prediction and segment.
model.fernwood.customer_lifetime_value.raw_code:
with rev as (
select d.customer_id, d.is_active,
coalesce(sum(case when f.order_status != 'cancelled'
then f.net_amount_usd end), 0) as net
from {{ ref('dim_customers') }} d
left join {{ ref('fct_orders') }} f on f.customer_id = d.customer_id
group by d.customer_id)
select customer_id, round(net, 2) as net_revenue_to_date_usd,
round(net * case when is_active = 1 then 0.45 else 0.12 end, 2)
as predicted_12m_value_usd,
case when net >= 1500 then 'vip' when net >= 600 then 'high'
when net >= 150 then 'mid' else 'low' end as ltv_segment
from rev

model.fernwood.mart_marketing_audience.name: mart_marketing_audience
model.fernwood.mart_marketing_audience.description: Opted-in customers with audience segments, synced to the email platform.
model.fernwood.mart_marketing_audience.raw_code:
select d.customer_id, d.email, s.first_name, v.ltv_segment,
case when v.ltv_segment in ('vip', 'high') and d.is_active = 0
then 'high_value_lapsed'
when d.is_active = 1 then 'active_engaged'
else 'reactivation' end as audience_segment,
1 as is_marketing_opted_in
from {{ ref('dim_customers') }} d
join {{ ref('stg_storefront__customers') }} s on s.customer_id = d.customer_id
join {{ ref('customer_lifetime_value') }} v on v.customer_id = d.customer_id
where s.is_marketing_opted_in = 1

model.fernwood.mart_email_engagement.name: mart_email_engagement
model.fernwood.mart_email_engagement.description: Email engagement per hashed recipient and campaign.
model.fernwood.mart_email_engagement.raw_code:
select recipient_email_sha256, campaign_id, 1 as sends, opened as opens,
clicked as clicks,
case when opened = 1 or clicked = 1 then touched_at end as last_engaged_at
from {{ ref('int_campaign_touches') }}

model.fernwood.mart_campaign_performance.name: mart_campaign_performance
model.fernwood.mart_campaign_performance.description: Campaign sends, open and click rates, and attributed revenue.
model.fernwood.mart_campaign_performance.raw_code:
with cust as (select customer_id, sha256(email) as h from {{ ref('dim_customers') }}),
attr as (
select t.campaign_id, count(distinct f.order_id) as orders,
sum(f.net_amount_usd) as revenue
from {{ ref('int_campaign_touches') }} t
join cust c on c.h = t.recipient_email_sha256
join {{ ref('fct_orders') }} f on f.customer_id = c.customer_id
and f.ordered_at between t.touched_at and datetime(t.touched_at, '+7 days')
where t.clicked = 1 and f.order_status != 'cancelled'
group by t.campaign_id)
select c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.channel,
count(t.recipient_email_sha256) as sends,
round(avg(t.opened), 4) as open_rate, round(avg(t.clicked), 4) as click_rate,
coalesce(a.orders, 0) as attributed_orders,
round(coalesce(a.revenue, 0), 2) as attributed_revenue_usd
from {{ ref('stg_marketing__campaigns') }} c
left join {{ ref('int_campaign_touches') }} t on t.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
left join attr a on a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
group by c.campaign_id

model.fernwood.mart_loyalty_members.name: mart_loyalty_members
model.fernwood.mart_loyalty_members.description: Loyalty program members with tier and in-store spend.
model.fernwood.mart_loyalty_members.raw_code:
select d.customer_id, d.email, d.full_name, k.date_of_birth, k.loyalty_tier,
k.loyalty_joined_at,
round(coalesce(sum(p.amount_usd), 0), 2) as in_store_spend_usd
from {{ ref('stg_crm__contacts') }} k
join {{ ref('dim_customers') }} d on d.customer_id = k.customer_id
left join {{ ref('stg_stores__pos_transactions') }} p
on p.loyalty_id = k.loyalty_id
and p.transacted_at >= datetime('2026-10-01 00:00:00', '-12 months')
group by d.customer_id

model.fernwood.mart_support_ticket_summa.name: mart_support_ticket_summary
model.fernwood.mart_support_ticket_summa.description: Support tickets matched to customers, with response times.
model.fernwood.mart_support_ticket_summa.raw_code:
select t.ticket_id, d.customer_id, t.requester_email, d.full_name as requester_name,
t.subject, substr(t.body, 1, 200) as body_excerpt, t.priority, t.ticket_status,
t.first_response_minutes, t.created_at
from {{ ref('stg_helpdesk__tickets') }} t
left join {{ ref('dim_customers') }} d on d.email = lower(t.requester_email)

model.fernwood.mart_finance_daily_revenu.name: mart_finance_daily_revenue
model.fernwood.mart_finance_daily_revenu.description: Daily gross, refunded and net revenue by channel.
model.fernwood.mart_finance_daily_revenu.raw_code:
with online as (
select date(ordered_at) as d, count(*) as n, sum(gross_amount_usd) as g,
sum(net_amount_usd) as net
from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} where order_status != 'cancelled' group by 1),
refunds as (
select date(processed_at) as d, sum(amount_usd) as r
from {{ ref('fct_payments') }} where payment_status = 'refunded' group by 1),
store as (
select date(transacted_at) as d, count(*) as n, sum(amount_usd) as g
from {{ ref('stg_stores__pos_transactions') }} group by 1)
select o.d as revenue_date, 'online' as channel, o.n as order_count,
round(o.g, 2) as gross_revenue_usd, round(coalesce(r.r, 0), 2) as refunds_usd,
round(o.net - coalesce(r.r, 0), 2) as net_revenue_usd
from online o left join refunds r on r.d = o.d
union all
select d, 'store', n, round(g, 2), 0, round(g, 2) from store

model.fernwood.mart_inventory_health.name: mart_inventory_health
model.fernwood.mart_inventory_health.description: Latest stock position, weeks of cover and sell-through by SKU and warehouse.
model.fernwood.mart_inventory_health.raw_code:
with latest as (
select sku, warehouse_id, snapshot_date, on_hand_qty
from {{ ref('stg_warehouse__inventory_snapshots') }}
where snapshot_date = (select max(snapshot_date)
from {{ ref('stg_warehouse__inventory_snapshots') }})),
sold as (
select p.sku, sum(i.quantity) / 3.0 as units
from {{ ref('fct_order_items') }} i
join {{ ref('dim_products') }} p on p.product_id = i.product_id
join {{ ref('fct_orders') }} o on o.order_id = i.order_id
where o.ordered_at >= datetime('2026-10-01 00:00:00', '-28 days')
and o.order_status != 'cancelled'
group by p.sku)
select l.sku, l.warehouse_id, l.snapshot_date, l.on_hand_qty,
round(l.on_hand_qty / nullif(s.units / 4.0, 0), 1) as weeks_of_cover,
round(coalesce(s.units, 0) / nullif(coalesce(s.units, 0) + l.on_hand_qty, 0), 4)
as sell_through_rate
from latest l left join sold s on s.sku = l.sku
